keyword.en: how to read concrete pump distance labels
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵输送距离的标题怎么读

title.en: Distance does not replace what Pumping-Distance Labels Differ on Pinjin Sheets lists
title.zh: 「距离」不能替换品锦参数页的输送距离标题为什么不一样列出的数字

description.en: Pumping-Distance Labels Differ on Pinjin Sheets. 120 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Distance.
description.zh: 品锦参数页的输送距离标题为什么不一样。120 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「距离」。

h1.en: Distance does not replace what Pumping-Distance Labels Differ on Pinjin Sheets lists
h1.zh: 「距离」不能替换品锦参数页的输送距离标题为什么不一样列出的数字

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not use one distance label on every concrete pump in Xingtai. Electric 20 lists one pair marked H / V, 120 m / 40 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械没有给邢台每一台混凝土泵用同一个距离标题。电动20标出一组标明水平/垂直的 120 m / 40 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance。

heading.zh: 物理学与几何学中的距离

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance: Distance board in Vizag cropped. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not use one distance label on every concrete pump in Xingtai. Electric 10 lists horizontal 25 m and no vertical line. Electric 20 is 120 m / 40 m. Do not swap the numbers because the second one is larger. These are not one H / V entry. That phrase is not 300 m borrowed from LZ-60.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance页上的Distance board in Vizag cropped。河北品锦机械没有给邢台每一台混凝土泵用同一个距离标题。柴油120为 150 m / 500 m。LZ-60 标出输送距离 100 m 和输送高度 300 m。如果工况需要格子里没有的高度，请用 /zh/contact/。

body.en: Electric 20 lists one pair marked H / V, 120 m / 40 m. LZ-80's height entry says consult factory standard. Electric 80 is 900 m / 300 m. Electric 15 lists vertical delivery height 15–20 m and horizontal delivery distance 60–80 m on two lines. Hebei Pinjin Machinery's concrete pump pages in Xingtai keep the label with the number. Use /en/contact/ if the job needs a height the entry does not contain.
body.zh: 电动20标出一组标明水平/垂直的 120 m / 40 m。电动30的细石行在同样的“先水平后垂直”标题下是 60 m / 180 m。河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵页面让数字和标题留在一起。

body.en: Electric 15 lists vertical and horizontal on separate lines. Read the label that is actually on the page. Diesel 120 is 150 m / 500 m. HBT80-16 lists horizontal conveying distance 120 m and delivery height 360 m. Electric 10 has a horizontal entry of 25 m and no vertical entry.
body.zh: HBT8018 把输送距离 150 m 和输送高度 450 m 分成两个标题。电动15把垂直输送高度 15–20 m 和水平输送距离 60–80 m 分成两行。LZ-80 的输送高度写的是咨询工厂标准。

body.en: HBT8018 lists conveying distance 150 m and delivery height 450 m as two labels. When the label says H / V or 水平/垂直, the first number is horizontal and the second is vertical. Electric 30's fine-stone row is 60 m / 180 m under that same horizontal-then-vertical label. LZ-60 lists conveying distance 100 m and delivery height 300 m. LZ-80 lists delivery height as consult factory standard.
body.zh: 标题写 H / V 或水平/垂直时，第一个数是水平，第二个数是垂直。HBT80-16 标出水平输送距离 120 m 和输送高度 360 m。这句话不是从 LZ-60 借来的 300 m。

question.en: On this row: On an H / V pair, which number is vertical?
question.zh: 水平/垂直这一组里，哪个是垂直？

answer.en: The second number. On Electric 80, 900 m / 300 m means 900 m horizontal and 300 m vertical. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance.
answer.zh: 第二个数。电动80的 900 m / 300 m 表示水平 900 m、垂直 300 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is Electric 30's second number larger?
question.zh: 为什么电动30的第二个数更大？

answer.en: The fine-stone label still says horizontal / vertical, and the entry lists 60 m / 180 m. Keep that order. Do not reorder it to look like Electric 20. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance.
answer.zh: 细石标题仍然是水平/垂直，格子标出的是 60 m / 180 m。保持这个顺序。不要为了看起来像电动20而重排。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is consult factory standard a height in metres?
question.zh: 咨询工厂标准是一个米数吗？

answer.en: No. That is the LZ-80 delivery-height entry. It is not a numeral. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance.
answer.zh: 不是。那是 LZ-80 的输送高度格。它不是数字。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can I add a vertical line to Electric 10?
question.zh: 可以给电动10补一行垂直距离吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery did not list one on that Xingtai concrete pump page. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance.
answer.zh: 不能。河北品锦机械没有在这台邢台混凝土泵页面上写出垂直行。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distance画面里印出的数字。
